text:
elaine: @sam @carlos quick one — CorporateBank dropped the final SIG/CAIQ and marked BYOK/HSM as a hard requirement for production. Sales is asking if we can accept compensating controls for the POC (dedicated capacity) so we can start next week. Need a security sign-off + list of evidence they want. Link to questionnaire: https://corpbank.example/q/435 (customer-only)

sam: can you paste the exact questionnaire wording for the BYOK ask and confirm which environment this applies to (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? also what's their decision deadline?

elaine: here's the excerpt they flagged:
```
Q: Are customer-managed keys (BYOK) required for data at rest in production?
Customer requirement: FIPS 140-2 HSM-backed keys for all production namespaces.
POC note: Customer asked if a temporary exception is possible during a limited POC on dedicated infra.
```
They want a yes/no from us by COB Thu. POC kickoff Mon.

carlos: rough proposal from solutions: allow POC on Dedicated with the following compensating controls (we'd ask customer to sign written RA):
- Dedicated VPC and tenant isolation for POC workloads
- Envelope encryption with Redwood-managed master wrapped by customer-supplied key material (partner HSM) where feasible
- Strict IAM scoping: KMS admin access restricted to named roles + IP allowlist for key ops
- Continuous audit logging shipped to customer-controlled log account + immutable retention (90d)
- Data minimization: mask/obfuscate any sensitive fields for POC datasets
- Weekly attestation from engineering that keys/access controls are intact during POC

sam: we need to map these to SIG/CAIQ controls and list evidence we'll provide. immediate asks from my side: network diagram showing VPC isolation, KMS access policy JSON, audit log delivery proof, and an operator runbook for key rotation/compromise. Also define the timebox: POC-only and auto-revert to default keys if we move to prod. Can you confirm we can produce those artifacts by Thu?

elaine: customer expects decision by Thu EOD. Sales will accept a temporary exception if security signs off. I can get them to limit data used in POC and sign the RA. They also agreed to postpone any production migration until we meet HSM requirements.

jason: from legal: we can accept a documented, timeboxed exception if all of the following are true:
1) Exception is limited to named POC tenant(s) and expires on a calendar date or on completion of POC
2) Sensitive data sets are minimized and masked where possible
3) Customer signs the RA and acknowledges residual risk
4) Redwood maintains audit logs and provides weekly attestation during the POC
I'll draft the RA and the sign-off language. We should avoid open-ended indemnities — will confirm wording in draft.

security-bot: ✅ New exception ticket created: SR-889. Please attach the mapping artifacts and the RA document to SR-889 for tracking.

sam: okay — provisional approval for POC only, provided we receive: network diagram, KMS policy, audit log delivery proof, attestation schedule, and the signed RA by customer + legal. I'll add the controls and timeline to SR-889. If any artifact is missing by Thu COB, exception is deferred.

elaine: thanks team — I'll coordinate with customer and attach artifacts to SR-889. Will ping if we need to escalate. :thumbsup:
